scope: Actual candidate provider adapters, synthetic read-only tool fixture, production provider credentials; no calls, customers, connector writes or database mutations.
credential_handling: SSH retrieval restricted to provider key names; captured in process memory, never printed or written to an artifact.
interpretation: All four actual providers accepted the adapter's request and completed a tool-result continuation. Times are whole buffered two-round turns from the local workstation, not single-model first-token latency or a production call SLO. One fixture is a transport and tool-contract smoke test, not proof of conversation quality.
luna_parameters: The live Luna request accepted temperature=0.2 with reasoning_effort=none and max_completion_tokens. Keep the functional temperature setting; do not preserve the older upstream comment that nondefault temperature always fails.
